text_block_list.text:
A supple frame sprinting powerfully past. 
That figure was undeniably "her."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line! Hands in the 
air!”

A phenomenal final straight— Leaving the 
trailing pack in the dust and pulling 
further ahead, a dominant 4-length 
victory!

My fingers tremble with excitement. And 
so, I dialed "her" number.
"—Hello?"

"Fufu. Yes, of course ...Thank you very 
much."

"‘You have accomplished it for me... 
Trainer...’"

...— Light is dancing... across the 
ceiling.

Consciousness gradually returns to 
clarity. It seems—it was all just a dream.

A distant future, the glory waiting at the 
end of the line... If I can dream a dream 
like this, I'd rather stay asleep 
forever—!

Nay, I shake my head. A dream is just a 
dream. Starting today, her Twinkle Series 
begins!

Steeling my resolve, as I hurried to the 
Trainer's Room—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let's start with crafting. 
What do you think?"

Cesario was accompanied by three of her 
contemporaries. First was Rhein Kraft: 
Cesario's close friend, a cheerful 
Umamusume who yearns to be a Tiara 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“My recommended race, huh...? Hmm, I'd 
have to say Mejiro Ramonu achieving the 
first Triple Tiara in history—”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, Air Groove-san's 
Oaks was amazing, but Hishi Amazon-san's 
Arima Kinen was too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I can't narrow it down to just 
one~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, okay! That's one way to answer! 
—Now, it's my turn!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My recommended race is—Naturally! My 
future race!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll put on a dazzling race that surpasses 
every single race in the Twinkle Series!

Here to prove her strength, the feisty 
Umamusume from America, Daring Heart. And—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well, both of them are... certainly quite 
unique.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Where's Messiah-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For me, it would have to be... the races 
where my mother excelled.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I've watched it countless times since I 
was little. It's my origin—a guiding light 
to follow, and my source of energy.

"Air Messiah—an earnest Umamusume who 
respects her mother, a prominent figure on 
the Tiara route, more than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: How about you, Cesario-san?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
For me... it would be Special Week-san's 
Japan Cup, I think.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly... that was the race 
where four world Derby Umamusume gathered 
in one place, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. No matter how many times I watch that 
fierce battle, my heart begins to race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her simply do what needed to be 
done straightened my spine more times than 
I can count—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's been a while since I've seen 
Cesario switched into 'on' mode outside 
the turf.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Normally I'm the gentle 'off' Cesario, and 
when it's time to get serious, I'm the 
cool 'on' Cesario! Have you gotten used to 
it by now?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Special Week-senpai is someone who walked 
the Triple Crown path and achieved great 
success.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san, will you also be pursuing the 
Classic Triple Crown route after your 
debut?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, I will take the Tiara route like the 
others. First, I'll aim for the Triple 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "For starters"... you say?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Cesario's dream is amazing, you 
know. It's so grand and far-reaching, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sounds fun! What is it, what is it? 
Please, tell me all about it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, well then. If you insist, just a 
little bit.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
My dream started with my mother. She was 
an instructor at a training club, and—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
She taught many young Umamusume the 
fundamental core of what it means to live 
as an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Cesario's Mother
text_block_list.text:
First, shall we try running outside 
together? Let's figure out a running style 
that truly suits you.

text_block_list.name: Mother's Student A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Running style—a way to channel our 
instinctual urge to run effectively into a 
race."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
At the club I used to go to, everyone was 
taught that thoroughly from the very 
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
First, tend to the roots, and provide the 
proper water and light... That is one of 
the most vital parts of education, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That was how my mother guided so many 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—The way my mother guided, saved, and 
pushed me forward was dazzling, even to my 
young heart.

text_block_list.name: Mother's Former Student A
text_block_list.text:
I want to share these feelings I have 
right now with Sensei, who I'm sure is 
watching on TV!

text_block_list.name: Mother's Former Student A
text_block_list.text: Teacher! I won~!

text_block_list.name: Mother's Former Student B
text_block_list.text:
Long time no see, Sensei. Actually, I'm 
working as an instructor now...

text_block_list.name: Mother's Former Student B
text_block_list.text:
There was a girl who raced for the first 
time the other day, and her running style 
looked just like yours, Sensei. ...Fufu, 
it somehow felt so ticklish and 
heartwarming!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The children raised by my mother will 
grace the races, carving out their own 
hoofprints for generations to come—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even after those legs cease their running, 
and your body withers with age like dry 
wood.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Becoming nourishment for the future that 
will come. Continuing to bring color to 
this great, endless river...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"That is the foundation. The embodiment of 
my mother, and—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: And that is precisely the form I seek.

text_block_list.name: Heart & Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...The foundation...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, first of all, I wish to forge 
my 'vessel' in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And so— "First," the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

"Yes. Cesario's dream lies beyond her run 
through the Twinkle Series— in the far, 
distant future."

Overwhelmed, the courtyard fell dead 
silent. Breaking that quiet—was a 
lighthearted laugh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Winning the Triple Tiara just to pad your 
resume, huh? That's quite an outrageous 
thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But—how exciting! Looks like we're gonna 
be great rivals. Just so you know, I'm not 
giving up the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's the path I must take to become 
Queen!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I won't back down either. After all, I 
intend to go there to fulfill my wish.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. I know full well that it's 
not something easily won.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's really about to begin now, 
isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I don't plan on letting anyone have it 
either. So—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to working with you in the 
Twinkle Series, Cesario, Ms. Heart, Ms. 
Messiah!

And so, the four of them exchanged bright 
smiles, boosting each other's morale...

Peers who inspire her to reach higher, and 
above all—Cesario's dream, so grand it 
takes one's breath away no matter how many 
times it's told...!

How could one not be filled with 
admiration! ...And that wasn't the only 
time such feelings welled up inside.

Even during the meeting we had at the 
start of training—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
My main goal is the Triple Tiara. 
Especially victory in the Oaks— I cannot 
let the crown of the Oak Queen slip away.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"So, if I may be so bold, I have devised a 
series of steps to achieve our goal."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
First, I'd like to use a timeline maker to 
visualize the necessary tasks, milestones, 
and deadlines to achieve this—

The knowledge and words flowing 
effortlessly from her would put active 
trainers to shame.

And out on the grounds afterwards, as 
well—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Haaah!!

Her legs supplely tore up the turf. 
Sprinting like a blast of wind, going on 
and on forever—

Tenacious lung capacity and supple joints. 
With overwhelming talent that leaves you 
utterly mesmerized—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*! ...Whew!

Everything, absolutely everything is 
wonderful.

“――Ah, stars of destiny! I offer you my 
thanks! How blessed a person I truly am!”

Thinking about the sheer good fortune of 
becoming your Trainer, lines from that 
comedy crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that you praised me so 
straightforwardly.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And that passionate gaze of yours, too. 
...It shows me loud and clear just how 
high your expectations are.

It seems it had shown on my face before I 
even realized it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No. Come to think of it, they've been full 
of passion ever since they scouted me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even when I close my eyes, I can remember 
that night vividly.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Dashing down the night road—under the 
yellow spotlight, as if practically 
falling to her knees.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Leading me to claim the Triple Tiara, and 
then supporting my dreams as my Trainer 
even after retirement—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying you will make the girl I 
raised win.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Train them, let them win, train them 
again, and let them win again. At the end 
of this endless cycle—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To establish together the prestige known 
as the "Cornerstone."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You swore to dedicate your life to me. It 
was because you are that kind of person 
that I chose you.

"……Hearing it repeated is a bit 
embarrassing, but I certainly did use 
those exact words when scouting her."

"That is precisely why the first thing 
that must be done is clear."
choice_data_list:
First, I want to aim for the Triple Tiara 
with you.
First, the Triple Tiara with you.

text_block_list.text:
"And after that, winning countless races, 
I will forge myself into a vessel worthy 
of the name 'Cesario.'"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... A sight that truly shows the fire 
ignited in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara—naturally, if one is to 
be the 'foundation,' it is an honor that 
must be claimed."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I ask that you steel your resolve once 
more. So that you may travel into the 
distant future with me.

"As if that night were playing out once 
more, my heart was pounding with fervent 
heat."

"I will make Cesario the 'cornerstone' of 
the future, without fail—" And so, the 
story of chasing that dream together with 
her began.
